public.text: Conformance should test more than data transmission. Laboratory and biobank systems need testing of identity matching, specimen traceability, consent enforcement, terminology validation, access control, audit trails and correction workflows.
public.suggestedRevision: Add test scenarios for participant-to-specimen linkage; parent–child specimen relationships; role-based access; consent withdrawal; provenance; offline capture and synchronisation; safe correction of records; and controlled exchange with authorised research systems.
